# CANDIDATE: BROKER_LATENCY_MONITOR

**Filed:** 2026-07-07
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)
**Type:** watcher_proposal
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

By instrumenting the order-gateway module to measure broker round-trip latency and alerting when it exceeds 500ms, we can monitor system health and log to STATUS.md for pre-session checks. This does not directly capture trading edge but helps avoid trading during high-latency periods that could lead to slippage or failed orders, thus protecting P&L.

## Mechanism

Add a timer in the order-gateway module around the order submission and acknowledgment receipt from the broker. If the round-trip time exceeds 500ms, log an alert to the system logger. Additionally, periodically (e.g., every minute) write the latest latency measurements to STATUS.md for pre-session review. The instrumentation will be non-blocking and use asynchronous logging to minimize performance impact.
